newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cinema says Imax legal action still on.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cinema says Imax legal action still on.

text.p: Cinema Plus Ltd, which has the exclusive contract for Imax cinemas in Australia, said on Thursday that Imax would continue its court action against World Odyssey in the United States.

On Wednesday, U.S.based entertainment group Showscan Entertainment Inc said the U.S. District Court in California had dismissed the great bulk of all claims for trade secret misappropriation asserted by Imax against World Odyssey.
Showscan is a sales agent for World Odyssey, a technology company specialising in projector manufacture.
"The court ruled that Imax's suit will go forward on all counts, except for part of one count," Cinema Plus said.
"Imax expects to be successful in its case against World Odyssey for trade secret misappropriation, breach of settlement agreement, unfair competition and civil conspiracy," it said.

Showscan said on Wednesday it plans to enter the giant cinema screen market in Australia with its local partner Reality Cinemas. Showscan is one of the world's largest providers of simulated rides, but has not yet branched into giant-screen technology. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
